annotations.title: Change the badge setting of a site

description: Set the "Built with SHIP" badge rule of a hosted site. With badge true, SHIP refuses a production deploy whose pages do not show the badge. With badge false, the site config decides. The change applies from the next production deploy. A plan that keeps the badge on refuses badge false, and the refusal says what to buy. Requires the config:write capability.

badge.description: true: require the badge on every page; false: let the site config decide

name: update_site
